headline: Traffic-led growth continues, restaurant margins tick down
summary_short: CAVA reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $368.4 million, up 31.3% y/y, as Same Restaurant Sales grew 9.0% on 5.3 points of guest-traffic growth and 17 net new restaurant openings; CAVA Restaurant-Level Profit Margin was 25.7%, down 60bps y/y on new-menu-item input costs and higher delivery mix.
summary_long: Revenue growth was driven by 94 net new restaurants opened since Q2 FY2025 plus 9.0% Same Restaurant Sales (5.3pts traffic, 3.7pts price/mix). Restaurant-Level Profit Margin fell 60bps y/y to 25.7% on Pomegranate Glazed Salmon input costs, a higher third-party-delivery mix, and wage investment, partly offset by sales leverage; G&A improved to 10.8% of revenue from 11.4%. Net income rose 25.3% y/y to $23.0 million on stronger operating performance, partly offset by a higher effective tax rate. Adjusted EBITDA grew 30.0% y/y to $54.7 million. CAVA reaffirmed fiscal-2026 guidance: 75-77 net new openings, 4.5-6.5% Same Restaurant Sales, 23.7-24.3% Restaurant-Level Profit Margin, and $181-191 million Adjusted EBITDA. Cash and investments totaled $435.6 million at quarter-end versus $393.0 million at fiscal year-end 2025.
